failure_classes.meaning: A defect was absent at the reviewed head and appeared in a later reviewer/reviser change.
The artifact violated a product, acceptance, security, or charter requirement before review.
The plan or acceptance criteria omitted, contradicted, or failed to operationalize required behavior.
Source, tests, or reproduction disproves a reviewer assertion.
Decomposition, ownership, or the implementation boundary was wrong.
A finding lacks product/acceptance/charter grounding or targets an unreachable non-trust-boundary state.
